name: Evlek Brand Film — V4.5 FINAL deliverable pair
note: Large binaries stay out of git (working rule 12); they are pinned here by checksum. Both are rendered from the Remotion source at the commit named below — the master is NEVER produced by transcoding a lossy MP4. To reproduce: render BrandFilmV4 with --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq --muted, then derive the social file with the exact ffmpeg command below.

social.encode_command: ffmpeg -i evlek_master_prores_v45.mov -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -level:v 4.2 -crf 10 -tune grain -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 60 -fps_mode cfr -x264-params keyint=300:min-keyint=300:scenecut=0:open-gop=0 -color_range tv -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 -movflags +faststart -an evlek_brandfilm_final_1080x1920_60fps.mp4
